scope: Read-only installed filesystem metadata and producer-software identity comparison; no calibration contents read

invocations.observations: Android-root symlink, two regular-file stat records, selected mountinfo entries and nvram_daemon process count; stable boot ID and launcher PID
Five installed software-file hashes compared in memory with locally manifest-verified retained inputs; stable boot ID and launcher PID

android_namespace: root of the observed Android init parent of the unique wmt_launcher process
limits: Current metadata does not establish the historical July runtime configuration.
File-size and inode equality do not compare the live record contents to the retained record.
Software equality does not identify which process, restoration branch or version wrote this file.
No daemon process at snapshot time does not mean it never ran.
PID continuity is not a complete process-lifetime oracle.
Factory calibration, board/firmware applicability and firmware acceptance remain unproved.
